name: mh-bookmark-organizer
description: Organize, dedupe, link-check, archive, tag and search browser bookmarks: a skill and an MCP server over a local engine that needs nothing but Python 3.9+.

interface.shortDescription: Tidy, dedupe, tag and search your bookmarks
interface.longDescription: Imports bookmarks from Chrome, Brave, Edge, Firefox, Safari and common export formats into a private local library, then finds duplicates and dead links, files and tags bookmarks, restructures the folder tree and exports back. Every change is proposed as a plan first, applied only after you approve it, and can be undone.
defaultPrompt: Use $mh-bookmark-organizer to show a health report for my bookmarks export and propose a cleanup plan.
Use $mh-bookmark-organizer to file my unfiled bookmarks into folders learned from my own.
